verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a system-on-chip, a hardware processor. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a service and identity capability that lies outside this product's category, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip ships any credential-issuance capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
